scope: Read-only source review and this design JSON only. No production code, process, queue, model, account or runtime receipt changed.

evidence_limits.native_routing_agent: in_progress_at_design_authoring; no completion or validation credited

MIT_notice.basis: LICENSE is byte-for-byte identical to complete fixed-commit upstream blob

subtle_limits: Upstream tracked files are clean; one untracked wheelbipeV14_2_aligned.urdf is outside this copied set.
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is copied completely as upstream wrote it; its referenced external licenses or listed algorithm/controller source files are not copied here.
This is byte/provenance verification only; no legal interpretation or online origin verification.

minimal_entry_architecture.dispatcher: Keep scripts/run_task_campaign.py TaskCampaign and its domain loop/process/account ownership. Add one explicit frozen integrated-plan opt-in in existing functions; no second dispatcher.
minimal_entry_architecture.training_worker: Keep scripts/train_chassis.py runner, native full-state restore, optimizer hook, save hook and pure-RL recovery rollout mask.
minimal_entry_architecture.advancement: Only frozen actor endpoint or charged cap in run_continuous_domain; no score-based gating, rollback, or deployment promotion.

static_freeze_required: A separately named canonical campaign revision and four static joint worker contracts, referenced by file/bytes/SHA. Target revision identifier and SHA remain pending.
Parent source_contract_file/SHA: speed -> actual REC v21 contract; terrain -> joint speed contract; jump -> joint terrain contract; stepjump -> joint jump contract.
Freeze static sampling/runtime recipe, source bindings, row provenance, component-start rules, physical identity and independent design expectations before any dynamic checkpoint selection.
Freeze integrated_lineage manifest source_root/run_root/campaign_plan/recovery_entry and four domain rows; recovery_entry actor_endpoint=15000; critic_warmup_updates=10.

Split integrated_runtime.apply output: dynamic learning_source/clocks are an admission receipt passed beside the contract, never included in contract hashing. Existing exact-old-worker prerequisite must be explicitly adapted to authenticated static joint recipe expansion.
Do not manufacture unknown future source commit/archive/SHA values or reuse source025 target identity.
static_and_dynamic_binding.worker_invocation_design: Existing train_command passes proposed explicit --integrated-lineage-plan/--integrated-lineage-plan-sha256 and --integrated-source-selection-file/--integrated-source-selection-sha256, plus existing resume/consumption/stage/task arguments. These options are design only and do not yet exist.
static_and_dynamic_binding.hash_cycle_rule: A worker contract cannot include a dynamic receipt whose selection contract_sha256 points back at that same contract. Contract sidecars remain exact static admitted contract bytes.

original_function_wiring.change: For explicit named integrated revision, authenticate static recipe, integrated manifest, all parents and physical identity; retain native train preflight/design_preflight and exact nontrain projections. Do not accept candidate audit as real startup evidence.

Use existing shared claim/lock/migration replay. Validate named source->target account migration with unchanged attempts/counters/caps. Archive previous independent completion records append-only and create a separate joint-segment admission record; old completed status must not skip new joint segment.

Under explicit opt-in, call integrated_lineage.admit_entry/select_learning_source. First speed is pinned real normal REC15000 full seal. Later first entries require normally completed preceding joint parent. Own resume candidates are explicit SHA-bound same-lineage references; never call legacy latest_checkpoint as a fallback. Preserve excluded legacy seals in historical audit without using their actor.

Pass the authenticated selection receipt and requested_total_updates from remaining_budget; retain consumed/actor-consumed/stage clock arguments. task_actor_update is selection fresh_domain_actor_updates, not legacy own-domain count. Worker revalidates every binding rather than trusting CLI claims.

Use integrated_lineage.remaining_budget against all old and new attempts; limit work by frozen joint domain actor endpoint and available charged total including remaining critic adaptation. Preserve original collect/spawn/persist/failure handling. Write joint_domain_finished_unassessed only after final full-state seal and completion at the declared endpoint; no implicit reopening from old terminal status.

Add one named joint revision route authenticating the exact REC/joint parent contract, strict frozen physical identity including solver iterations and closure gap, neural interface, 4096x24, fixed1e-4 and no coarse fallback. Keep all historical revision validators unchanged.

Under opt-in, re-read actual source seal/infos and selection, require full native state, correct lineage/source/domain/component clocks and allowance, reject legacy own sources, and verify task/stage/global consumption arguments. Keep existing invocation and caps checks.

Authenticate static integrated worker/recipe and SHA-bound dynamic admission receipt before Env; synthesize effective training config and install validated source component clocks before construction. Retain independent actual runtime/design validation. Nontrain roles use original exact fixed contracts.

Opt-in remaining adaptation comes from authenticated selection:10 only for first cross-domain entry, saved remaining for same-joint-own restart, zero extra after finished adaptation. Keep native warmup_updates=parent_updates+remaining rule.

Add integrated lineage/runtime/sampling/reuse source files, frozen SCUT manifest+six files and all static/dynamic recipe references to original source inventory and verify bytes/SHA. Preserve existing recursive named-source and actuator-evidence inventory.

Use original actor/critic/Adam restore and verify_learning_state_restore, restore CPU/env/CUDA RNG, initialize source component clocks, then restart physical episodes at restored clocks. Increment joint/domain/component clocks only after committed actor-enabled optimizer updates. Persist identical integrated_lineage and integrated_runtime_clocks in progress/completion/infos/per-file seal using the same real counters.

metadata_contract.component_math: REC=15000+fresh_joint_actor_updates. Each acquired component=joint_actor_updates-component_start_joint_actor_updates; new stage start is actual completed joint parent actor count. No planned or legacy endpoint supplies a component base.
metadata_contract.save_math: derive metadata at save from authenticated starts plus report.actor_updates_in_block; critic-only updates increment charged/model learning counts, not joint/domain/component actors. Do not reset counters from CLI or dynamic proposal.
metadata_contract.completion_rule: model_final.pt, per-file seal and completion.json agree with actual contract/source and clocks; domain_complete and completion integrated_lineage match the normally completed joint record.
metadata_contract.fresh_clock_bound: Revalidate actual REC origin seal on selection. fresh joint actors <= both learning_lineage delta and actor_updates_consumed delta from that origin; absent snapshot charges do not become fresh joint learning.

accounting.allowance: min(20000-old_and_joint_domain_spent,121000-all_spent) minus authenticated critic_warmup_remaining; require positive actor allowance. Completed joint own is never reopened.
accounting.reservation_rule: Keep original max(successful_updates,attempted_updates) consumption, including crash uncertainty and updates not represented in the selected snapshot. Preserve every briefly executed old speed update and critic adaptation.
accounting.source_model_vs_account: model learning_lineage follows selected full model; parent_updates/consumed account follows latest durable shared account even when joint source REC is older than old-speed consumption. Do not collapse these clocks.

minimal_boundary_sequence: Keep REC source023 running to actual normal actor15000 endpoint; no earlier stop or score gate.
Authenticate real REC final seal, source contract, normal completion, full actor/critic/Adam/RNG and schedule record.

If legacy supervisor enters independent speed before code adoption, wait for its first completed native full snapshot, request one native save_stop, then await exact owner exit and durable account/seal reconciliation; charge all that work.

Before replacing only a waiting observer, re-read singleton/shared-lock status and verify it has no durable signal/launch intent. If intent already exists or source025 launch occurred, reconcile that actual normal lifecycle first; this report grants no concurrent signal or competing launch.

Freeze distinct named joint target source archive/commit/manifest and extend original queue validation/reconciliation only for that exact target. Retain pid/starttime or pidfd identity, lock, durable once-intent and append-only receipts.
First joint speed explicitly rebases from REC15000 rather than old speed actor; all later stages inherit preceding joint full seal. No deployment is declared by this design.
required_before_real_launch: Final immutable code/source inventory including finished native routing
Named static campaign/worker/recipe/preflight expectations and migration validators
Actual REC normal final source with allowance against latest account
Exact new target archive/commit/manifest SHA and owner/singleton evidence
Native full restore and mixed-row startup checks on actual admitted source; no existing CPU test receipt substitutes for them

explicit_rejections: Legacy latest own checkpoint fallback, even with a newer consumed counter
Old independent finished domain status skipping its new joint segment
Actor-only transfer, invented optimizer/RNG reset, or additional critic warmup on ordinary restart
Reset/refund of historical, failed, reserved, critic or transient old-speed charges
Clock bases inferred from planning, desired endpoint or stale ledger rather than actual source model
Dynamic checkpoint selection embedded into immutable target contract bytes
New dispatcher, ability gate, automatic deployment claim, or unsupported native/remote success receipt
